BiblicalUsage: David sank the stone into Goliath's forehead, leprosy rose up in Uzziah's forehead as he burned incense, the golden plate rested on Aaron's forehead to bear the iniquity of the holy things, and Ezekiel was told Israel was impudent and hardhearted, hard of forehead. The forehead is where defiance and holiness both show.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the forehead tells the truth about a man: Goliath's fell to a stone, Uzziah's broke out in leprosy, Aaron's bore the holy plate, and Israel's was hard against God. A hard forehead against God is the most dangerous place a man can stand.
RelatedPeople: King David; Aaron; Uzziah, King of Judah
